newsitem.title: FRANCE: Truckers seal off key Paris region petrol depot.
newsitem.headline: Truckers seal off key Paris region petrol depot.

text.p: Striking French truckers on Tuesday sealed off a petrol depot in Grigny south of Paris, which supplies ninety percent of petrol sold in hypermarkets in the capital and the surrounding region, officials said.

The national traffic information centre said the Grigny depot in the Essone region was shut off by several trucks on the ninth day of a protest by truckers demanding wage hikes, shorter working hours and retirement at 55 instead of 60.
The centre said it had counted 171 blockades on roads across the country. Among new roads targetted were the A31 motorway between Nancy and the Luxembourg border, and the A4 motorway east of Reims.
In certain regions including the Pas-de-Calais in northern France, local officials have since Monday imposed rationing of petrol supplies to private car-owners to avert possible shortages.
